name: Securify
summary: Country blocker and fraud filter for Shopify: blocks countries, IP ranges, bots, VPNs and risky emails at checkout, and holds suspicious orders automatically.
best_for: stores seeing real fraud or bot traffic that want country, IP, VPN and email-risk rules plus automatic holds on suspicious orders, and who will review the block log rather than set and forget
skip_if: you are blocking on a hunch rather than on measured fraud — start by reading your order data, because a blocked legitimate customer never tells you they were blocked
honest_knock: Blocking by country and IP is a blunt instrument and it cuts both ways: every rule that keeps out a fraudster also keeps out a customer travelling, using a corporate VPN, or living behind a carrier NAT. The app is honest enough to give you a live log of what it blocked, and that log is the part to actually read — a rule set nobody reviews quietly costs sales. Also worth separating in your head: blocking bots from your analytics is a reporting fix, while blocking fraud at checkout is a money fix, and the two need different rules.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-20 on apps.shopify.com/easy-block-customer-ip-country) Free plan plus three paid tiers, unchanged since the readings of 18 August and 13 September 2026. Free: unlimited countries and IPs, last 1,000 visitor records, 500 blocked visitors a month. Pro $5.99 a month or $49.99 a year (30% less), Advanced $9.49 or $79.99 a year (30% less), Growth $49 or $490 a year (17% less). Trials are 3 days on Pro and Advanced and 7 days on Growth. Rating 4.6 from 95 ratings (78 five-star, four four-star, two three-star, one two-star, ten one-star). Listed as 'Country Blocker Fraud Securify' from siimple.ai, with Shopify's Built for Shopify badge and Shopify Flow actions and triggers.
